items.interpretation: The checklist asks for distinct configuration/result records and defensible comparison semantics. It does not require equal original-paper scores or a single causal ranking across all method families. Existing accepted adapted results and common-condition mechanism comparison meet this storage/reporting requirement with explicit labels; neither a fixture nor experimental status substitutes for the separately accepted real-method evidence.
boundaries: Reference profiles are descriptive; common trace is mechanism evidence, not matched-quality or latency benchmarking.
Historical single-seed deviations, unmeasured costs/timing, and unavailable paper-matched evidence remain visible.
No new paid run or arbitrary cross-family ranking is required to close this output-separation requirement.

minor_documentation_reconciliation.issue: Unqualified statement that full I14/R05 acceptance remains outstanding is stale after accepted November record. Replace with link to current per-requirement disposition; retain exact-tag/full-smoke limits.
Historical P08h/P10d/P10s progress notes still say work/results/I14 pending. Preserve dated development history but add a current-status cross-reference so it cannot contradict final acceptance.
Avoid saying all 15 profiles are adapted quality studies: there are 14 adapted method profiles plus one Native mechanism profile (16 recipe files total).
